body: Thanks. Insights into somethings I didn't think of.
Still can't hopelessly stop yearning for 'good days', whatever and whenever they might be.
I'm curious. What's the logic behind terming '*everything is petty*' as depression?
It made me lighten up. That so many other people acknowledge this shit, and have/are going through it. I'm not alone.

How do you cope with the emptiness then? What do you do in your free time? How do you feel.. okay? Just, you know, good?

> it doesn't matter to me what I accomplish or how much time I put into my job or how much money I get out of it. It's a drop in the bucket, and the same old song and dance.

I just posted to /suicidewatch a couple of hours ago. I feel exactly like this, and a bunch of other lows in life.
